visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor studio setting with a bright red backdrop. A woman with long hair wearing a black leather jacket and a red fringed shawl stands next to a man in a black suit. They gesture towards the camera and a white table holding three large mahjong-themed gift boxes. (2) The man is seated at the table. He attempts to bite into a red apple but his face contorts in pain, showing his teeth. A photographer in a tan hoodie is visible in the foreground holding a professional camera. (3) A montage shows close-ups of the man's pained expressions while biting the apple. The screen transitions to black and white with dramatic text overlays. A client wearing a grey cap points at a monitor showing the awkward photos, looking displeased. (4) The woman in the red shawl bows repeatedly to the client in apology. She then turns to the man and scolds him while he holds his jaw. (5) The man attempts to drink a cold yellow beverage from a glass. He winces and grabs his cheek again. The client looks increasingly frustrated. (6) The scene shifts to a white-walled room where the woman hands the man a tube of Sensodyne toothpaste. (7) Close-up shots show the man brushing his teeth with the toothpaste. Large blue and gold text graphics appear on screen detailing product benefits. The man looks relieved and happy. (8) Back in the red studio, the man successfully bites the apple and drinks the beverage with a bright smile. Promotional graphics for a giveaway appear at the bottom. The woman in the red shawl holds the product box and smiles at the end.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat pop background music with a steady synthesized beat. The female voice introduces the man with high energy and rising intonation. (2) A mechanical clicking sound of a camera shutter triggers a shift. The photographer gives brief instructions. A crisp, percussive sound of biting an apple is heard, immediately followed by a sharp intake of breath and a muffled vocal groan from the man. (3) A sudden orchestral 'sting' SFX with heavy harmonic tension plays as the man winces. A new female voice (the client) speaks with an authoritative and sharp tone. (4) The agent's voice becomes apologetic and high-pitched. This is followed by a loud 'slap' or impact SFX as the music cuts, replaced by aggressive scolding from the agent. (5) Liquid pouring and ice clinking sounds are heard. The man groans again in a low pitch after a drinking sound. A melodramatic organ sound effect plays for emphasis. (6) The acoustics change to a clean studio narration. A professional, mid-pitched male voice enunciates product features over a light electronic bed. Sound effects of toothbrush bristles against teeth are synchronized with visual close-ups. (7) Upbeat BGM resumes. A loud, satisfying 'crunch' sound of an apple is followed by a relieved exhale from the man. The narrator continues with a high speech rate listing promotional details. (8) A final bright chime SFX marks the end of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Problem -> Struggle -> Solution -> Positive Result
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Sensodyne toothpaste by humorously depicting a new actor's struggle with tooth sensitivity during a commercial shoot, showing how the product solves the issue and enables him to perform successfully.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video centers around a problem that is solved specifically by the Sensodyne product, which is shown in detail with promotional text and slogans.
